title: stex.hermes.agent-config.v1
description: The company (team) configuration owned by the STEX inference service: each native Hermes profile's persona, skills and default model, and the model chosen for each task. Product servers relay it with the shared secret; browsers never call the inference service. See README.md#agent-configuration-v1.

profileId.description: One of the eight persistent native profiles. The set is fixed by the charters; the configuration never adds, renames or removes a profile.

modelId.description: An OpenRouter model id (vendor/model, optional :variant). Refused whatever the catalog says: any id or name naming Anthropic or Claude, and any router that chooses a model for itself (the `openrouter/` vendor, an id or name containing `route`, `router` or `routing`, or `auto` as a word or `:auto` variant), because a router may pick Claude.

revision.description: Opaque revision of the whole configuration (16 lower-case hex). An update must name the revision it was made from; a stale one is refused with STALE_CONFIG.

sigil.description: A typographic emblem drawn from a fixed set of glyphs (text, never generated artwork).

displayName.description: Presentation name. The profile id never changes.

temperaments.description: Up to three temperament ids from the document's `temperaments` list; pairs it marks as opposed are refused.

voice.description: Free text added to the profile's persona (its Hermes SOUL). It cannot remove the fixed STEX boundaries, which are always appended after it.

discipline.description: Read-only: the profile's name in its specification.

mission.description: Read-only: the mission in the profile specification.

state.description: Read-only runtime state from runtime-profiles.json. Configuration never activates a parked profile.

skills.description: Equipped skills: a subset of allowedSkills.

allowedSkills.description: Read-only: the skills the profile specification lists.

personaApplication.description: Read-only: how the persona reaches Hermes. `per-request` means each turn carries it; `profile-sync` means an operator step writes it to the profile; `parked` means the profile runs no turns, so its persona, loadout and default model are recorded for when it is activated.

requires.description: Capabilities a chosen model must report in the catalog.

application.description: Read-only: `per-request` tasks take effect on the next turn; `profile-sync` tasks (Hermes's own side calls) take effect when the operator applies the profile.

stack.description: The default model stack (Grok through OpenRouter). Reset restores these.

boundaries.description: Read-only: the fixed STEX boundaries appended after every persona. Shown to the user, never editable.

freeMode.description: Added 2026-11-21 (suite D-022). Igor's free mode: a free model for Igor's own conversation sandbox only. `task` and `scope` are fixed facts; Frige, Hermes and Igor turns about a project always keep their paid models. The model is kept when the mode is turned off. Absent from a service without free mode.

update.description: PUT /v1/agent-config. Partial: only named members and tasks change. `reset: true` restores the defaults and ignores team and tasks.

freeMode.description: Added 2026-11-21 (suite D-022). Fields left out keep their saved values. Turning the mode on needs a model, saved or named here, that the catalog marks `free`; a free model is refused for every other choice.

catalog.description: GET /v1/agent-config/catalog: OpenRouter's public model list, filtered (never Anthropic or Claude), cached by the inference service.

source.description: `openrouter` when fresh, `cache` when the last good copy is served, `defaults` when only the default stack is known.

pricing.description: US dollars per million tokens, as OpenRouter reports them; null when unknown.

recommended.description: True for the default Grok stack.

description.description: Added 2026-11-21. OpenRouter's description reduced to at most 280 characters of plain text, for display only; may be empty.

free.description: Added 2026-11-21 (suite D-022). A free endpoint: a `:free` variant, or priced at zero for prompt and completion. Offered only for Igor's free mode.

actor.description: The signed-in principal the product server reports, or `local`.
